title: "Graph Connectivity"
subtitle: "Fully Connected Graphs and Islands"

### Connected Graphs

Graphs are fully connected if there is a path between every pair of vertices. If there exists a pair of nodes for which you cannot reach one from the other by traversing the graph, the graph is not fully connected. 

Examples:

#### Fully Connected Graph

E.x.

<div id="intro-static-graph"></div>
:::

#| echo: false

    {"id": "C", "label": "C"},
]
intro_edges = [
    {"id": "e0", "source": "A", "target": "B", "label": ""},
    {"id": "e1", "source": "B", "target": "C", "label": ""},
]

ojs_define(intro_nodes = intro_nodes, intro_edges = intro_edges)
```

  { nodes: intro_nodes, edges: intro_edges },
  { width: 320, height: 220, directed: false }
);
```

### Islands

#### Question: Count the number of islands in a graph

An island is a group of nodes that are not connected to any other nodes in the graph. 

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true"}
## Hint

Every node you can possibly visit from a given starting node is part of the same island. Thus we can simply traverse the graph and count the number of times we have to start a new traversal to visit all the nodes in the graph.
:::

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true"}
## Code Help

1. Start with a random first node and traverse the graph. Record all nodes being visited. This is the first "island".
2. Look for a node that has not been visited. If you find such a node it means that this node is not connected to the first "island". Increment the count to record a new island. Start a new traversal from this nodes. 
3. Repeat the process until you have visited all the nodes in the graph.

Tip: Use a recursive function to traverse the graph.
:::

Drag the blocks below into a plan for counting islands. Click any block to
toggle between the plain-language description and the Python code. Container
blocks (ones that end with `:`) can hold nested blocks.

::: {.panel-grid}
::: {.panel}
<div id="islands-blocks"></div>
:::
::: {.panel}
<div id="islands-viz" class="cb-viz-placeholder"></div>
:::
:::

```{python}
#| echo: false
# Sample graph with 3 islands: {0,1,2}, {3,4}, {5,6}
islands_nodes = [
    {"id": "0", "label": "0"},
    {"id": "1", "label": "1"},
    {"id": "2", "label": "2"},
    {"id": "3", "label": "3"},
    {"id": "4", "label": "4"},
    {"id": "5", "label": "5"},
    {"id": "6", "label": "6"},
]
islands_edges = [
    {"id": "e0", "source": "0", "target": "1", "label": ""},
    {"id": "e1", "source": "1", "target": "2", "label": ""},
    {"id": "e2", "source": "0", "target": "2", "label": ""},
    {"id": "e3", "source": "3", "target": "4", "label": ""},
    {"id": "e4", "source": "5", "target": "6", "label": ""},
]

ojs_define(islands_nodes = islands_nodes, islands_edges = islands_edges)
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
import { mountCodeBlocksView } from "./js/code-blocks-view.js";
import { GraphEngine } from "./js/graph-engine.js";
import { mountIslandsVizView } from "./js/islands-viz-view.js";

islandsBlocks = mountCodeBlocksView(document.querySelector("#islands-blocks"), [

  { id: "visited", code: "visited = set()", label: "initialise visited as an empty set" },
  { id: "count0", code: "count = 0", label: "initialise count as 0" },

  { id: "def_dfs", code: "def dfs(node):", label: "define dfs function", container: true },
  { id: "mark", code: "visited.add(node)", label: "record node as visited" },
  { id: "for_neighbor", code: "for neighbor in graph[node]:", label: "for each neighbor of node", container: true },
  { id: "if_unvisited", code: "if neighbor not in visited:", label: "if neighbor is not visited", container: true },
  { id: "recurse", code: "dfs(neighbor)", label: "traverse the neighbor" },

  { id: "for_node", code: "for node in range(n):", label: "for each node from 0 to n-1", container: true },
  { id: "if_new", code: "if node not in visited:", label: "if node is not visited", container: true },
  { id: "inc", code: "count += 1", label: "increment count by 1 — found a new component" },
  { id: "call_dfs", code: "dfs(node)", label: "traverse everything reachable from node" },

], { preplaced: ["count0", "visited", "def_dfs", "for_node"] });

islandsEngine = new GraphEngine(
  { nodes: islands_nodes, edges: islands_edges },
  { directed: false }
);

islandsViz = mountIslandsVizView(
  document.querySelector("#islands-viz"),
  islandsEngine,
  {
    getPython: () => islandsBlocks.toPython(),
    width: 400,
    height: 260,
    stepDelayMs: 820,
  }
);
```
